tables.title: Past Perfect Tense (الماضي التام) - القاعدة الأساسية الأولى
rows: Our team **had practised** before they played the match.
Our team **hadn't practised** before they played the match.
**Had** our team **practised** before they played the match?
tables.explanation:
🔥 **القاعدة الأساسية الأولى في الدرس 4**

الماضي التام (Past Perfect) يُستخدم للتعبير عن حدث وقع وانتهى **قبل** حدث آخر في الماضي.

📌 **متى نستخدمه؟**
- عندما نريد ترتيب الأحداث في الماضي.
- مع كلمات مثل: **before, after, by the time, when, because**.

📌 **كيف نكوّنه؟**
- **had** + التصريف الثالث للفعل (past participle).
- الفعل يكون في التصريف الثالث دائماً.

📌 **الفرق بين Past Simple و Past Perfect:**
- **Past Simple:** حدث واحد في الماضي.
- **Past Perfect:** حدث وقع قبل حدث آخر في الماضي.
tables.examples:
📝 **أمثلة من الدرس:**
1. I had cleaned my room before my dad arrived.
2. The kids had had some ice-cream before they went back home.
3. Laura repaired her glasses because her mother had broken them.
4. By the time the bell rang, I had already finished working.
5. We reached the railway after the train had left.

tables.title: Reported Speech (الكلام المنقول) - القاعدة الأساسية الثانية
rows: They said: 'The Falls are beautiful.' → They said the Falls **were** beautiful.
She said: 'I visited the Falls.' → She said she **had visited** the Falls.
He said: 'I have visited the Falls.' → He said he **had visited** the Falls.
She said: 'I am trying.' → She said she **was trying**.
He said: 'I will go.' → He said he **would** go.
tables.explanation:
🔥 **القاعدة الأساسية الثانية في الدرس 4**

الكلام المنقول (Reported Speech) يُستخدم عندما ننقل كلام شخص آخر.

📌 **متى نستخدمه؟**
- عندما ننقل ما قاله شخص ما.
- نستخدم أفعال النقل مثل: **said, told, asked, added**.

📌 **كيف نغيّر الأزمنة؟**
- نغير زمن الفعل إلى زمن ماضٍ (نقله خطوة إلى الماضي).

📌 **قاعدة عامة:**
- **Present → Past**
- **Past → Past Perfect**
- **Present Perfect → Past Perfect**
- **will → would**

📌 **الفرق بين said و told:**
- **said:** بدون مفعول به مباشر. (She said she was tired.)
- **told:** مع مفعول به مباشر. (She told us she was tired.)
tables.examples:
📝 **أمثلة من الدرس:**
1. Direct: 'The Falls are beautiful.' → Reported: They said that the Falls had been beautiful.
2. Direct: 'I visited the Falls.' → Reported: Tourists said they had visited the Falls.
3. Direct: 'I am tired.' → Reported: Tom said he was tired.
4. Direct: 'I went home early.' → Reported: Sarah said she had gone home early.
5. Direct: 'We haven't seen Omar.' → Reported: They told us they hadn't seen Omar.

tables.title: Passive Voice - Present Simple (المبني للمجهول)
rows: Iguazu Falls **are located** on the Iguazu River.
tables.explanation: يستخدم المبني للمجهول في المضارع البسيط عندما يكون الفاعل غير معروف أو غير مهم، والتركيز على المفعول به.
tables.examples:
Iguazu Falls are located on the Iguazu River.
Helen Keller was born in Alabama.
The food at the open market is sold there.

tables.title: Articles (أدوات التعريف والتنكير)
rows: قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بحرف ساكن
قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بحرف متحرك
the Iguazu River, the open market
tables.explanation: تستخدم أدوات التعريف والتنكير لتحديد الأسماء.
tables.examples:
Iguazu Falls are located on the Iguazu River.
Alhambra Palace is an ancient fortress.
Portugal enjoys a warm temperate climate.

tables.title: Prepositions - Means of Transport (حروف الجر مع وسائل النقل)
rows: by plane, by bus, by car, by train
tables.examples:
You can choose to go by plane.
She travels by bus.
He came by car.

tables.title: Present Simple - Subject-Verb Agreement (المضارع البسيط - اتفاق الفاعل مع الفعل)
tables.explanation: في المضارع البسيط، نضيف 's' للفعل عندما يكون الفاعل مفرداً (He, She, It).
tables.examples:
Iguazu National Park offers many activities.
The tourists visit the Falls every year.
The weather changes quickly.

tables.title: Go + ing (التعبير عن الأنشطة)
rows: go canoeing, go trekking, go swimming
tables.explanation: نستخدم 'go + v-ing' للتعبير عن الأنشطة الترفيهية والرياضية.
tables.examples:
You can go canoeing in the Iguazu river.
They went trekking in the mountains.
We go swimming every summer.

tables.title: Superlative Adjectives (صفات التفضيل)
rows: the best, the greatest, the tallest
the most beautiful, the most wonderful
tables.explanation: تستخدم صفات التفضيل للمقارنة بين ثلاثة أو أكثر.
tables.examples:
Iguazu Falls are one of the best places in the world.
Vancouver is the greatest city in the world.

tables.title: Time Conjunctions (روابط الزمن)
rows: We reached the railway **after** the train had left.
The kids had ice-cream **before** they went back home.
**When** I was in town, a woman came up to me.
**By the time** the bell rang, I had finished.
tables.explanation: روابط الزمن تستخدم لربط جملتين زمنيتين وبيان العلاقة الزمنية بينهما.
tables.examples:
We reached the railway after the train had left.
The kids had ice-cream before they went back home.
By the time the bell rang, I had already finished working.

tables.title: Reported Speech - Reporting Verbs (أفعال النقل)
tables.explanation: أفعال النقل تستخدم لنقل الكلام: 'said' بدون مفعول به، و'told' مع مفعول به.
tables.examples:
Ruba and Sana told us they had been to the market.
She said she was tired.

tables.title: Quantifiers - Negative (المحددات في النفي)
rows: يستخدم في النفي والأسئلة مع الأسماء غير المعدودة
tables.explanation: نستخدم 'any' في النفي والأسئلة مع الأسماء غير المعدودة.
tables.examples:
I haven't got any money.
She doesn't have any friends.
Is there any milk?

tables.title: Word Forms (اشتقاقات الكلمات)
tables.explanation: يمكن اشتقاق كلمات جديدة من الكلمات الأساسية بإضافة لواحق.
tables.examples:
I like to visit historical places.
The scenery is so beautiful.
He is an adventurous person.
